info.title: Paid to Sort v2 API: Part Scanner section
info.description:
**DRAFT 1** (Chris's process: draft → review → rebuilt twice into a clean final spec). Local work in progress; not deployed.

Shaped to merge into pts-v2's `/api/v1/openapi.json` (server `/api/v1`, paths under `/scanner/`, operationIds and components prefixed `scanner`/`Scanner`).

Every request needs an API key (`Authorization: Bearer …`). Identity, roles and keys belong to Accounts and Security; the scanner only reads the scopes A&S gives it.

Every POST/PATCH needs `Idempotency-Key`. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with `code` and `request_id`. Lists use `limit` + `cursor`. snake_case, UTC ISO 8601, money in integer cents with `currency`.

Photos are never uploaded or stored; one small crop per part is named on the server by the free recognizer tier and held in memory for that call only.

api_key.description: Every caller needs a key. Issued and verified by Accounts and Security (no partner role yet; a scoped partner key (for example for Bricqer) can be added later because every query is owner-scoped). Local tests use fake `pts_test_…` tokens.

post.summary: Send one crop; the server names it and makes a card
post.description: The crop (max 300 KB) is named by the free recognizer tier on the server, held in memory for that one call and never stored. Top score below 0.70, or the top two within 0.05, gives `check_by_hand` with no pre-pick. Recognizer trouble is never turned into "no match": the card is saved as `error` (so Retry works) and the answer is a real error (429 / 502 / 504) carrying `card_id`. Our own cap (100 per hour per person) gives 429 `rate_limited` and makes no card.

post.summary: Make an export (BSX, CSV or JSON)
post.description: Scope `exports:create` (admin only for staff). Approved cards only, one lot per drawer + type + part + color + condition. Dropped, set-aside (incl. Parts We Need), unknown, held and parted-out cards are left out. BSX: BrickStore XML, `Remarks` = drawer code, `Comments` = card note, no Price or Cost. Never overwrites: each export gets its own file name. 409 `not_finished` while open.
